# AgenticRoslynTool

> A .NET 10 command line tool that splits C# files into one type per file across a whole repository, so a codebase can enable StyleCop SA1402. dotnet format cannot do this because the SA1402 code fix has no Fix All. Not an MCP server. Agent friendly: --dry-run, --json report on stdout, exit codes 0/1/2/3. Default phase is content, which rewrites files; always plan first.

- [README](https://github.com/rjmurillo/agentic-roslyn-tool/blob/main/README.md): install, usage, safety, limitations, FAQ
- [Fix SA1402 across a whole repo](https://github.com/rjmurillo/agentic-roslyn-tool/blob/main/docs/fix-sa1402-whole-repo.md): why dotnet format does nothing, three step workflow
- [One type per file without ReSharper](https://github.com/rjmurillo/agentic-roslyn-tool/blob/main/docs/one-type-per-file-without-resharper.md): bulk options compared
- [SA1402 and SA1649 naming](https://github.com/rjmurillo/agentic-roslyn-tool/blob/main/docs/sa1402-sa1649-naming.md): file names for generic and same name types
- [Verification](https://github.com/rjmurillo/agentic-roslyn-tool/blob/main/docs/verification.md): what each check proves
- [Roslyn MCP vs CLI](https://github.com/rjmurillo/agentic-roslyn-tool/blob/main/docs/roslyn-mcp-vs-cli.md): when an agent needs which
